title: Restatement § 87 — option recitals and reliance
summary: The book connects signed recitals and preparatory reliance to protection of offers.
notes: At p. 248 the note discusses a signed recital, a fair proposed exchange, and disagreement over unpaid nominal consideration. At p. 258 the notes identify § 87(2) with Drennan’s rationale and ask whether preparations to cross the bridge can qualify. The two subsections address different routes. The complete section is not reproduced in these assigned pages.
